hunks.baseline: I quickly skimmed the messages, then erased a dozen or so with a single wave of my hand.
hunks.sol: I skimmed the messages, then erased a dozen or so with a single wave of my hand. There were still more holographic windows I needed to check.

hunks.baseline: There were still more holographic windows I needed to check.
Overwhelmed by both joy and bitterness, I remembered the Thunderbolt Saber King smiling brightly as he said he would pass everything he had on to me.
hunks.sol: Caught between joy and bitterness, I remembered the Thunderbolt Saber King smiling brightly as he said he would pass everything he had on to me.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, I engraved one thing deep in my heart.
This enormous reward I’d been given was payment for the lives of the dead.
hunks.sol: I etched one thing deep in my heart: these enormous rewards had been paid for with the lives of the dead.

hunks.baseline: I’d never had much of a comfortable life, and debt had always been a miserable thing to me. But not this time.
hunks.sol: I’d never been well-off, and debt had always been a miserable thing to me. But not this time.

hunks.baseline: The day I finally cleared this entire debt, the peace everyone wanted would arrive.
hunks.sol: The day I finally paid it all back, the peace everyone wanted would arrive.

hunks.baseline: And to make that happen, I had to endure and overcome whatever hardships and adversity came my way.
hunks.sol: And to make that happen, I had to endure and overcome whatever hardships came my way.

hunks.baseline: I couldn’t let grief make me collapse, or settle for the present. I had to keep moving toward higher places, never giving up.
hunks.sol: I couldn’t collapse under my grief or settle for where I was. I had to keep moving higher, with no thought of giving up.

hunks.baseline: Toward the place I’d glimpsed while completing Transmitting Internal Energy Across the Body, hidden behind thick clouds.
hunks.sol: Toward the place I’d glimpsed while completing Transmitting Internal Energy Across the Body, hidden behind thick, billowing clouds.

hunks.baseline: Of course, I knew it was no easy feat.
hunks.sol: Of course, I knew it wouldn’t be easy.

hunks.baseline: Even the Three Saints, the greatest masters in the Central Plains, and Jeok Cheongang, who stood shoulder to shoulder with them, might not have opened their upper dantian. I couldn’t be sure.
hunks.sol: I couldn’t even be sure whether the Three Saints, the greatest masters in the Central Plains, or Jeok Cheongang, who stood shoulder to shoulder with them, had opened their upper dantian.

hunks.baseline: A pang of regret suddenly crossed my mind.
hunks.sol: A pang of regret struck me.

hunks.baseline: *I would’ve failed. And the odds would’ve been very high.*
hunks.sol: *I would’ve failed. Almost certainly.*

hunks.baseline: The more I thought about it, the more indescribably frustrating it felt. But looking at it objectively, it had been a very good decision…
hunks.sol: The more I thought about it, the more frustrating it felt. But looking at it objectively, it had been a very good decision…

hunks.baseline: I suddenly furrowed my brow as I remembered the excruciating process of Transmitting Internal Energy Across the Body and the strange dream that had come from memories that weren’t mine.
hunks.sol: I furrowed my brow and thought back to the excruciating process of Transmitting Internal Energy Across the Body, then to the strange dream born of memories that weren’t mine.

hunks.baseline: The inexplicable déjà vu that had suddenly taken hold of my entire body was telling me there was a trace of a memory, somewhere in between, that had been ground away.
hunks.sol: The inexplicable déjà vu sweeping through me pointed to the trace of a memory worn away somewhere between the two.

hunks.baseline: Staring blankly into empty air like a man in a trance, muttering the same words over and over, I eventually recovered part of a memory that had been forgotten.
hunks.sol: I stared blankly into empty air, muttering the same words over and over like a man in a trance. At last, I recovered part of the memory I’d forgotten.

hunks.baseline: My head had grown hot from turning the thought over and over for so long.
hunks.sol: After turning the thought over for so long, my head felt hot.

hunks.baseline: No—invisible little awls were slowly burrowing into my mind.
hunks.sol: No—an invisible little awl was slowly burrowing into my mind.

hunks.baseline: A headache spread through me.
hunks.sol: A headache spread.

hunks.baseline: But even as the pain made me wince, I kept rummaging through my thoughts. I searched the darkness for a tiny fragment hidden beneath larger memories.
hunks.sol: But even as the pain made me wince, I kept searching my memory. I groped through the darkness for a tiny fragment hidden behind larger memories.

hunks.baseline: I remembered myself, realizing it wasn’t time yet and turning away from the upper dantian beyond the clouds.
hunks.sol: I remembered realizing it wasn’t time yet and turning away from the upper dantian beyond the clouds.

hunks.baseline: And then, as I slipped into a trance where I lost all sense of self, someone’s words echoed faintly in my ear.
hunks.sol: Then, as I slipped into the world of No-self, someone’s words echoed faintly in my ear.

hunks.baseline: Before I knew it, my eyes had flown wide open.
hunks.sol: My eyes flew wide open.

hunks.baseline: Was it because I’d realized who the voice belonged to?
hunks.sol: Because I’d realized who the voice belonged to?

hunks.baseline: It was because an immense pain had suddenly struck me.
hunks.sol: Because an immense pain had suddenly struck me.

hunks.baseline: Hngh.
hunks.sol: Hk.

hunks.baseline: The unexpected pain made me suck in a breath on instinct. I clenched my teeth and squeezed my eyes shut.
hunks.sol: I sucked in a breath on instinct. Clenching my teeth wasn’t enough; I squeezed my eyes shut, too.

hunks.baseline: The headache that had been slowly burrowing into my mind like an invisible awl had grown as huge as the long acupuncture needle the Medicine King Hall Master carried around like a prized weapon, and it was now tearing through my head.
hunks.sol: The headache that had been slowly burrowing into my mind like an invisible awl had grown as huge as the long acupuncture needle the Medicine King Hall Master carried around like a prized weapon. Now it was tearing through my head.

hunks.baseline: Even in the middle of all this, though, I couldn’t let go of the one question in my mind that remained unanswered.
hunks.sol: Even then, I couldn’t let go of the one question still unanswered in my mind.

hunks.baseline: Who was the owner of that voice that had rung out like a hallucination at the last moment?
hunks.sol: Who did that voice, which had rung out like a hallucination at the last moment, belong to?

hunks.baseline: Who could speak to me in a space inside my mind, rather than in the real world?
hunks.sol: Who could speak to me in a space inside my mind rather than in the real world?

hunks.baseline: The voice I’d heard at that moment belonged neither to Jeok Cheongang nor, even less so, to the Thunderbolt Saber King.
hunks.sol: The voice I’d heard belonged neither to Jeok Cheongang nor, least of all, to the Thunderbolt Saber King.

hunks.baseline: I couldn’t guess whether they were a woman or a man. And if they were a man, I couldn’t even tell whether they were young or old.
hunks.sol: I couldn’t guess whether they were a woman or a man—or, if they were a man, how old they might be.

hunks.baseline: All I could vaguely recall was the sensation of that moment—the feeling I’d dredged up while enduring that terrible headache.
hunks.sol: All I could vaguely recall was the sensation of that moment, dredged up at the cost of enduring that terrible headache.

hunks.baseline: It felt as unfamiliar as something I’d never heard before, and yet there was a faint, peculiar sense that I knew it.
hunks.sol: The voice seemed as unfamiliar as something I’d never heard before, yet faintly, peculiarly familiar.

hunks.baseline: And that was all I managed to recover.
hunks.sol: And that was all I could recover.

hunks.baseline: A flash of light exploded. The whiteness in my vision slowly receded, and focus began to return to my blurry eyes.
hunks.sol: A flash of light exploded. The whiteness in my vision slowly receded, and my blurred sight began to come back into focus.

hunks.baseline: I let out the breath I’d been holding and realized that the pain, which had seemed like it would go on forever, had finally ended.
hunks.sol: I let out the breath I’d been holding and realized that the pain, which had seemed as though it would go on forever, had finally ended.

hunks.baseline: Along with the pain, the memory I’d been allowed to recover had reached its limit, too.
hunks.sol: And with it, the memory I’d been allowed to recover had reached its limit.

hunks.baseline: I stared silently at my fingertips, trembling with the remnants of the pain, then clenched them tight.
hunks.sol: I stared silently at my fingertips, still trembling from the pain, then curled them into a tight fist.

hunks.baseline: Crack.
hunks.sol: Crunch.

hunks.baseline: The skin of my palm, now almost like iron after undergoing Bone Transformation, pressed taut against my sharp fingernails.
hunks.sol: The skin of my palm, now almost like iron after Bone Transformation, pressed taut against my sharp fingernails.

hunks.sol: Perhaps it was the strange turmoil of my emotions.

hunks.sol: At that very moment, the vast qi sleeping inside my body began to boil—

hunks.baseline: As I stared at the Quest title on the holographic window, I opened my tightly shut lips.
hunks.sol: I stared at the Quest title on the holographic window, then parted my tightly shut lips.
